entries.test: Tesla's product offerings and reported revenue sources as of March 2024 would establish whether its business was principally making electric vehicles.
entries.note: The board's likely recognition is hedged; the underlying description of Tesla's business is asserted.

entries.test: Public statements, disclosed board records, or credible reporting could establish whether an independent Tesla board questioned when its AI and supercomputer investments would generate returns.
entries.note: The prediction depends on an independent board and supplies no deadline.

entries.test: Public evidence available by March 28, 2024 of generative AI applications delivering demonstrated practical benefits would test the claim that no meaningful use case had been proved.
entries.note: Meaningful allows some judgment, but the categorical denial has a plain reading about demonstrated practical utility.
This reports the author's inability to envision profitability, rather than firmly predicting that xAI will never profit. Subsequent profits would not settle what he could imagine when writing.
